scope: References added or corrected in the final literature review. Earlier entries are in research/phase7/references_verified.json and research/phase7_extension/references_added.json.
method: Each record was matched in Crossref by DOI (title, authors, venue, volume, issue, pages, year) or in the arXiv API (title, authors, dates, comments); published versions of preprints were searched in Crossref by title. Where a full text was legitimately accessible (arXiv, institutional repository) the passage supporting the claim was read; otherwise the claim is limited to the abstract. Peer-review status is recorded; preprints are marked in the bibliography.
not_accessible: ScienceDirect pages of the three structural examples returned HTTP 403; their open-access copies in the Zaguan repository were read instead (see LITERATURE_REVIEW_FINAL.md, section 8).
The ISR submission guidelines still redirect to the Springer login from this environment (not re-read).
IEEE Xplore, Springer and ScienceDirect full texts behind paywalls were not read; claims about those works rest on their abstracts or on their arXiv versions, as stated per record.

references.title: Learning From Planned Data to Improve Robotic Pick-and-Place Planning Efficiency
references.what_was_read: Crossref record; arXiv:2506.15920 full text (preprint version) read: Sect. on comparison with analytical methods, Table I (time to solution, candidates attempted), experiments in simulation and real-world settings
references.claim_in_manuscript: learns from planned data which candidates are shared grasps; faster than checking every candidate analytically, but more motion-planning attempts than the analytically filtered set (Table I of the arXiv version: rows T and N); closest precedent to M1. The published version (RA-L 11(2):2026-2033, 2026) supersedes the preprint previously cited
